sentence: Admission to the graduate nursing program or permission of the instructor.

argument: The sentence uses 'or' to connect two distinct conditions ('Admission...' and 'permission...'), meaning satisfying either one is sufficient. According to the CTDL definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition, this represents a context where 'more than one alternative condition or path has been defined and from which any one path fulfills the parent condition.' Therefore, the root node is an 'any_of' grouping these two text items.
